title: bot.ability.speaking.output
description: An utterance finished: the text it was asked to say, the part the mouth actually played, the part it did not, how it ended, the bot's own voice id once learned, and the audio format it was said in.

text.description: The text this utterance was asked to say: its parts' words, joined exactly as written.
text.title: Text

spoken.description: The words of the audio the mouth reported played, in order, as the encoder aligned them: what the room actually heard. Audio cut short partway through the words aligned to it says those words in proportion to the share of it that played, rounded down to whole words. Empty when nothing was played.

unspoken.description: The rest of the words the encoder read: what was never played, in order.

outcome.description: How the utterance ended: completed (every piece played), stopped (cut short on request), abandoned (its text stopped coming before it was final), or failed (encoding failed, or the mouth dropped audio unplayed or stopped reporting playout).

voice_id.description: The bot's own voice id, once it has learned it by hearing itself; null until then. Heard voices carry it as voice:<voice_id>.

media_type.description: Media type of the encoded audio (e.g. audio/pcm, audio/wav).
media_type.title: Media Type

sample_rate_hz.description: Sample rate of the encoded audio in hertz, when known.
sample_rate_hz.title: Sample Rate Hz

channels.description: Channel count of the encoded audio, when known.
channels.title: Channels

examples.text: Sure. I can help with that.
examples.spoken: Sure. I can help with that.
